root_cause.primary: The inherited stage icon rendered 24x24 Tabler paths through a manual uniform Scale into 20x20 logical pixels and relied on the default Shape renderer.
root_cause.secondary: PySide6's bundled Qt 6.11.1 does not ship the QtQuick.VectorImage QML module; the system Qt installation does, but the application process uses the PySide6 module set.
root_cause.result: GeometryRenderer tessellation plus non-integer stroke scaling produced soft/uneven small glyphs.
